pass1.element: Composer send while the host connection is down
pass1.decision: Refuse and keep the draft: one sentence, the text stays in the box, nothing replays

pass1.element: Stop button and the stopping state
pass1.decision: Stopping state plus a per-job list (organ, job, cancelled / still running / unknown) that collapses to one line once settled

pass1.element: Header status mark + sentence, and state-gated controls
pass1.decision: One sentence per project with a fixed precedence; neuron state as node badges in the graph

pass1.element: Liveness when the host is busy, and the retry breaker
pass1.decision: Three states (idle draws nothing / busy / stalled-in-warn) from organ heartbeats, plus an intent-hash retry breaker

pass1.element: Connection loss and reconnect
pass1.decision: A lasting per-organ connection state with last error and next retry, never silenced

pass1.element: Turn receipt and REVERT
pass1.decision: Per-turn receipt: 'N changes in layer X', Revert mutes the layer, refusal names the stronger opinion that depends on it

pass1.element: Approval card layout, verbs, countdown and settled states
pass1.decision: A parked-proposals tray (an inbox) with counts in the header; the graph node of the parked neuron carries the same badge and opens the card

pass1.element: How a turn limit is surfaced
pass1.decision: Three-part closing sentence (limit / last effect / how to continue), written as provenance and drawn in the turn

pass1.element: What the agent may do alone, and how a denial is worded
pass1.decision: A denial turns into a parked proposal on the same surface, so deny and approve are one path

pass1.element: Concurrency: one running task, refused in a sentence
pass1.decision: Per-organ and per-budget admission, refused in a sentence naming the limit

pass1.element: History persistence, scene switching, and closing the panel
pass1.decision: Session layer per project, rebind waits for in-flight wakes, close = detach

pass1.element: Keyboard and focus behaviour
pass1.decision: Composer conventions as observed, plus a global Stop key (e.g. Escape twice or Ctrl+.) with its hint read from the binding

pass1.element: Colour: surfaces and the text grey ramp
pass1.decision: One seed grey with elevation offsets and contrast-solved text roles; quiet below three rungs comes from form

pass1.element: Typography: size scale, weights, families
pass1.decision: Three sizes, sans for words and mono for identifiers, quiet by caps and tracking

pass1.element: Colour roles: accents, actions, verdict hues
pass1.decision: Two accents (action, live presence) plus a muted verdict trio, enforced by a hue-count test

pass1.element: Status display: health cells and fidelity readouts
pass1.decision: Five distinct marks (verified, broken, unknown, idle, working) with the reason inline on degraded

pass1.element: Progress and liveness mark
pass1.decision: A per-node ring: length is completed steps, rotation is heartbeat, with distinct stop-requested and confirmed-cancelled states

pass1.element: Long-job progress visual
pass1.decision: Determinate cell field when the organ reports counts, indeterminate sweep otherwise

pass1.element: Agent result: structured rows instead of prose
pass1.decision: A compact one-line receipt on the node plus the full rows in the inspector

pass1.element: Authorship and decision credit layout
pass1.decision: Key column = writer or sublayer, value = opinion, ordered by strength

pass1.element: Agent transcript presentation
pass1.decision: Ruled turns with the rule coloured per writer, prim paths as locate chips

pass1.element: Approval / gate card
pass1.decision: A parked-proposal card: phrase header, mono operation, bold consequential verb, visible border

pass1.element: Spacing rhythm, density, region layout
pass1.decision: Named roles on a 4-px grid with gaps that step down with nesting depth

pass1.element: Scene and stage state visualisation; node-editor conventions
pass1.decision: A layer-stack step list per prim, with a left verdict rule and delta colours
